title: Agent is getting stuck during generation, burns API usage pretty quickly on retry
body: Working on an app built entirely by CC. I am unable to work further, as any operation, even those with a cleared context will hang the tool in an analyzing state. Running with debug and verbose flags, here's an example: Have tried setting the SHELL= prompt to bin/bash instead of zsh, no change in behavior. Stopping and retrying seems to burn API spend quickly. Running on OS X ARM
author: jeremycyr
